<p><b>Bartering</b> is a <a href="/w/Gameplay" title="Gameplay">gameplay</a> mechanic that allows <a href="/w/Player" title="Player">players</a> to exchange <a href="/w/Gold_ingot" class="mw-redirect" title="Gold ingot">gold ingots</a> for various items with <a href="/w/Piglin" title="Piglin">piglins</a>.
</p>

<div class="mw-heading mw-heading2"><h2 id="Mechanics">Mechanics</h2><span class="mw-editsection"><span class="mw-editsection-bracket">[</span><a href="/w/Bartering?section=1&veaction=edit" title="Edit section: Mechanics" class="mw-editsection-visualeditor"><span>edit</span></a><span class="mw-editsection-divider"> | </span><a href="/w/Bartering?action=edit&section=1" title="Edit section's source code: Mechanics"><span>edit source</span></a><span class="mw-editsection-bracket">]</span></span></div>
<p>Adult piglins can trade gold ingots for certain items when they pick up nearby gold ingot items or when the player <span class="explain" title="Defaults to right click on mouse or left trigger on controller.">uses</span> gold ingots while looking at them. After the piglin takes the gold ingot and examines it for 6 seconds (120 gameticks) in <a href="/w/Java_Edition" title="Java Edition"><i>Java Edition</i></a> it tosses a random item to the player, or upward if no player is in sight. The full cycle time, from when a piglin accepts an ingot until it accepts the next ingot, is 6.05 seconds (121 gameticks) in <a href="/w/Java_Edition" title="Java Edition"><i>Java Edition</i></a> and 8 seconds (160 gameticks) in <a href="/w/Bedrock_Edition" title="Bedrock Edition"><i>Bedrock Edition</i></a>.<sup id="cite_ref-1" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-1"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>1<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup> Baby piglins take the ingot, but do not barter; they instead store the ingot in their inventory. <a href="/w/Piglin_brute" class="mw-redirect" title="Piglin brute">Piglin brutes</a> ignore gold ingots and do not barter.
</p><p>Piglins can pick up other items that are in the <code>piglin_food</code> or <code>piglin_loved</code> tags; however, gold ingots are the only items that piglins accept for bartering.
</p><p>Hitting a piglin causes it to "confiscate" the ingot; the piglin does not complete the barter. It cannot be bartered with again unless it puts another item in its inventory. Piglins who are killed in one hit before they finish examining always drop the ingot.
</p><p>When a piglin is examining a gold ingot, it can still be angered when the player breaks a container or a gold-related block nearby, although its behavior differs depending on the game edition. In <a href="/w/Java_Edition" title="Java Edition"><i>Java Edition</i></a>, the piglin finishes the barter on the original schedule and starts attacking the player only after the barter finishes. In <a href="/w/Bedrock_Edition" title="Bedrock Edition"><i>Bedrock Edition</i></a>, the piglin immediately finishes the barter and starts attacking the player,<sup id="cite_ref-2" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-2"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>2<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup> leading to a bartering transaction much shorter than the default 8 seconds.<sup id="cite_ref-3" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-3"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>3<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup> This allows piglins in <a href="/w/Bedrock_Edition" title="Bedrock Edition"><i>Bedrock Edition</i></a> to barter rapidly when gold-related blocks are repeatedly broken nearby or repeatedly pushed and pulled by pistons.
</p>
<figure class="mw-default-size mw-halign-right" typeof="mw:File/Thumb"><a href="/w/File:Piglin_Admiring_Item_JE1.png" class="mw-file-description"><img src="/images/thumb/Piglin_Admiring_Item_JE1.png/120px-Piglin_Admiring_Item_JE1.png?76e6c" decoding="async" loading="lazy" width="120" height="160" class="mw-file-element" srcset="/images/thumb/Piglin_Admiring_Item_JE1.png/240px-Piglin_Admiring_Item_JE1.png?76e6c 2x" data-file-width="600" data-file-height="800"></a><figcaption>A piglin looking at a gold ingot.</figcaption></figure>
<p>Bartering is controlled by the <a href="/w/Loot_table" title="Loot table">loot table</a> <code>minecraft:gameplay/piglin_bartering</code>. If the <a href="/w/Game_rule" title="Game rule">game rule</a> <span class="explain" title="Before JE 1.21.11: mobGriefing"><code>mob_griefing</code></span>‌<sup class="nowrap Inline-Template" title="">[<i><span title="This statement only applies to Java Edition"><a href="/w/Java_Edition" title="Java Edition">JE</a>  only</span></i>]</sup> or <code>mobgriefing</code>‌<sup class="nowrap Inline-Template" title="">[<i><span title="This statement only applies to Bedrock Edition"><a href="/w/Bedrock_Edition" title="Bedrock Edition">BE</a>  only</span></i>]</sup>  is <code>false</code>, piglins barter only when the player <span class="explain" title="Defaults to right click on mouse or left trigger on controller.">uses</span> a gold ingot on them.
</p><p>In <a href="/w/Java_Edition" title="Java Edition"><i>Java Edition</i></a>, if a piglin is zombified into a <a href="/w/Zombified_piglin" class="mw-redirect" title="Zombified piglin">zombified piglin</a> before the bartering is complete, the newly zombified piglin drops the gold ingot immediately. In <a href="/w/Bedrock_Edition" title="Bedrock Edition"><i>Bedrock Edition</i></a>, the zombified piglin continues to hold the gold ingot after zombification and drops it upon death.
</p><p>When a piglin is admiring a gold ingot while bartering, it does not run away from nearby <a href="/w/Zoglin" title="Zoglin">zoglins</a> or zombified piglins.
</p><p>Piglins sometimes pick up and equip the <a href="/w/Iron_boots" class="mw-redirect" title="Iron boots">iron boots</a> enchanted with <a href="/w/Soul_Speed" title="Soul Speed">Soul Speed</a> at a random level that they have just offered while bartering. A player wanting to obtain the iron boots without killing the piglin can induce the piglin to discard the iron boots by offering a pair of <a href="/w/Golden_boots" class="mw-redirect" title="Golden boots">golden boots</a>.<sup id="cite_ref-4" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-4"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>4<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup>
</p>
